The issuer shows moderate liquidity with a current ratio of 1.44 and profitability with an EBIT margin of roughly 14% (EBIT of 2,660M on revenue of 19,133M). However, leverage is high, with total liabilities about 78% of total assets and equity at only ~22% of assets, which limits downside resilience. Overall, this supports an investment-grade but pressured profile.  

DECISION: BBB-
